stories.title: OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably
stories.summary: OpenAI is making GPT-6.2 Sol the new default model in ChatGPT's chat tab, rolling it out worldwide. In internal tests, image understanding jumped from 47.4 to 71.7 percent, and the model now handles difficult instructions correctly 78.1 percent of the time. It also sticks to safety policies more consistently. The article OpenAI updates ChatGPT to handle complex everyday questions, web searches, and images more reliably appeared first on The Decoder .

stories.title: GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy
stories.summary: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra independently produced a machine-verifiable Lean proof of Smoktunowicz's gap theorem, the first of its kind according to Vals AI. The model chose its own approach because key foundations were missing from Mathlib. On Autoform-Hard, Astra now leads the leaderboard with 49 of 56 tasks solved. The article GPT-6.2 Astra solved a math theorem no other AI could crack, then invented its own proof strategy appeared first on The Decoder .
